acceptance: Every remaining `optional: true` timeout entry in scripts/sql_execution_gate/expected_differences.json has a justification that matches current hosted-run evidence
PostgreSQL q20 and the Havoc 8_v10/9_v1 timeouts no longer need to be tolerated, or are recorded as required entries with a reason
sql-execution-evidence passes on hosted CI at the changed head with no timeout
description: Leftover from PR #4007 (SQLite q16 gate fix). (1) PostgreSQL TPC-H q20 (and the tpchavoc 20_v1..20_v10 variants) plus tpchavoc 8_v10 and 9_v1 hit the 15 s statement timeout on every hosted run; they are `optional: true` entries in scripts/sql_execution_gate/expected_differences.json, which exempts them from the stale-entry check, so they would also hide a regression. Decide per entry: raise the budget, add PostgreSQL indexes like the SQLite fix, or make them required entries with a current justification. (2) The remaining optional SQLite entries still say 'without indexes' and are probably obsolete now the indexes landed (SQLite's slowest query was 4.4 s over ten hosted runs): tpcds_obt q35 timeout, the tpcds vacuous q13 entry (marked optional because of SQLite timeouts), and any other optional SQLite timeout wording. Remove them or make them non-optional, verified with hosted runs of sql-execution-evidence. (3) Also review the optional PostgreSQL tpcds_obt q56 entry. PR #4007 already pruned the SQLite timeout entries for tpcds 13/48, tpch 21, tpchavoc 5_v8/21_v*, and the tpcds_obt base-equivalence 13/48 entry.
